record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The five units in appliesTo declare skill DEFAULT in this production reference (Egg, Substitute and the three pillars; all have maxPP 0). The catalog lists no other unit with skill DEFAULT. DEFAULT is a placeholder skill: the registry maps it to the plain AbilityStrategy base class.
record.summary: Placeholder skill with no ability-specific effect. If it is ever cast, the base AbilityStrategy.process spends maxPP (0 for all five units), increments the caster's ult count, broadcasts the default ability animation and records the skill in the team's cast list; it deals no damage, applies no status and moves nobody. OnAbilityCastEffect effects on the caster still run after the cast.

targeting.who: none: the base process only reads the target's position for the animation broadcast
targeting.note: requiresTarget keeps the base default true, but nothing is done to the target.

effects.resolution: the only state changes in the base process are pp = max(0, pp - maxPP), count.ult += 1, an animation broadcast and a push to the team's abilities-cast list

starBehavior.note: no star-dependent value in the base process; the units have stars 1 (Egg, Substitute, Pillar Wood), 2 (Pillar Iron), 3 (Pillar Concrete) by the catalog.

record.positionalConditions: None read for the cast itself. The pillars have passive INANIMATE and toAttackingState returns immediately for INANIMATE units, so they do not enter the attacking state through that method. canAttack (freeze, sleep, resurrecting, skydiving, tree) is a separate gate.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes; each cast repeats the same bookkeeping.
record.rawVsResolved: No raw or resolved amounts: the placeholder has no numeric effect.
